# Design-system public prop and axis matrix

Generated by `node scripts/ds-api-matrix.mjs`; check freshness with `--check`. Curated decisions live in `packages/design-system/api/axis-policy.json`.

The compiler resolves **252 callable public components and compound parts**. Every declared prop is retained in the [JSON evidence](../superpowers/specs/audit-evidence/2026-09-06-api-prop-matrix.json); repeated inherited DOM/dependency props reference its shared catalog. This page shows package-owned props and inherited semantic/DOM-integration axes. Hooks, constants, and standalone type exports are inventoried separately in JSON and covered by the declaration snapshot.

**How to read the evidence:** Meaning is source JSDoc unless a policy is explicitly marked reviewed. A parameter initializer is a source expression, not an evaluated value. `No parameter initializer` is an extraction fact; read the reviewed runtime-default summary for body fallbacks, dependency behavior, browser defaults and context. Requiredness is retained separately for each overload/union branch in JSON. Long types are abbreviated here; JSON retains the complete strings. Literal values expose named union aliases; they are not an exhaustive domain when the type also accepts non-literals. DOM forwarding, state ownership and defaults are explicit implementation reviews, not deductions from event/ref types. These reviews document intentional limitations as well as supported behavior; they are not exhaustive browser certification.

## Reviewed axis policy

| Axis | Meaning and scope | Migration rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>variant</code> | A named visual recipe within a component family. The word alone does not imply status or identical values across families. | Keep established family-specific values when they express different concepts. Introduce a named replacement plus a deprecation path only when the same concept is represented inconsistently. |
| <code>tone</code> | Semantic communication such as information, success, warning, or danger. Decorative identity hues and categorical chart series are distinct concepts. | Do not rename decorative Avatar.variant or chart category colors to status tone. Check the component's allowed subset instead of adding every tone everywhere. |
| <code>size</code> | Family-relative geometry or density. Button height, Avatar diameter, text scale, and Empty composition are not one common pixel scale. | Preserve intentional family scales and document their dimensions. Do not globally replace small/medium with one abbreviated enum or reinterpret layout choices as fixed heights. |
| <code>width/height</code> | Physical or constrained layout dimensions; literal numbers and named presets require the owning component's units and meaning. | Do not collapse a dialog's width preset into the control size axis. Existing numeric layout APIs retain CSS pixel semantics where documented. |
| <code>id/ids</code> | An inherited DOM id identifies an element for labels, descriptions, and focus. Record keys or a displayed list of identifiers are data and must be described as such. | Do not replace domain identifiers with DOM ids or route DOM integration props to a hidden input when the visible trigger owns the accessible relationship. |
| <code>action/actions</code> | Usually rendered action content. A function-valued prop instead needs its explicit invocation and ownership contract; inspect the type before assuming either meaning. | Keep ReactNode/ReactElement slots composable. Do not turn a slot into an event callback under the same name; introduce a distinct handler API if needed. |
| <code>empty</code> | Content or configuration shown when data is absent. String fallback, ReactNode slot, and structured recovery state are different contracts. | Retain the smallest useful contract for each component. No blanket rename or widening to a function/ReactNode without checking rendering and accessibility. |
| <code>icon</code> | An icon constructor and a preconstructed element are distinct APIs. Before/after positions are explicit slots; a semantic icon may be provided by the component. | Preserve Banner's typed constructor override and Button's element slots. Any future unification needs a new adapter or deprecated compatibility path, with sizing and decorative accessibility preserved. |
| <code>change-handlers</code> | Native onChange receives a DOM event; domain controls may report a value; Radix adapters use onValueChange/onCheckedChange. Closing requests and async saves are separate operations. | Do not rename every callback to onChange. Preserve payloads, optionality, controlled/uncontrolled ownership, and promise/rejection behavior when proposing replacements. |
| <code>appearance</code> | Family-specific presentation treatment, such as Badge fill emphasis or Spinner foreground treatment. Distinct from semantic tone; values need not match unrelated components. | Preserve established family recipes and their interaction with tone/variant. A shared name is not grounds for merging different visual concepts. |
| <code>value/defaultValue/checked/open</code> | May be caller-controlled state, uncontrolled initialization, native form metadata or display-only data. Each component review identifies ownership and payload; presence of a value prop alone does not imply a controlled input. | Preserve controlled/uncontrolled boundaries and reset behavior. Do not repurpose displayed values or native event handlers as semantic state APIs. |

### Accordion

Source: <code>packages/design-system/src/components/accordion.tsx:88</code>. 268 additional inherited props are retained in JSON.

DOM target: **reviewed** — Root div; native attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded; asChild composes one child. dir follows LedgerProvider unless explicit..

Control: **reviewed** — Root controls string selection in single mode or string-array selection in multiple mode, with value/onValueChange or initial defaultValue. No coercion or child inspection.

Runtime defaults: **reviewed** — type required. Closed without initial selection. Single requires collapsible to close its open item; multiple permits independent toggles. disabled defaults false.

### Avatar

Source: <code>packages/design-system/src/components/avatar.tsx:398</code>. 264 additional inherited props are retained in JSON.

DOM target: **reviewed** — Base UI Avatar root span owns the accessible image name, data-slot/size/variant/shape and caller style; native span props and ref target it. It does not clip overflow, so a Badge sits on its corner; the photo and the fallback carry the radius. A loaded Image is decorative within it; the Fallback holds the circle otherwise..

Control: **reviewed** — Base UI tracks the photo's loading status (idle, loading, loaded, error) from Image; a different src is attempted again. All identity, hue, shape and size inputs remain caller-owned; inside a Stack, size, variant and the decorative default come from the stack context unless given.

Runtime defaults: **reviewed** — size=small (24px), variant=neutral, shape=circle; in a Stack, the stack's size and variant. Non-decorative name labels the span as an img; decorative hides it; explicit role, aria-label and aria-hidden override. title defaults to name. Missing hue hashes name into six hues. Without children, src renders Avatar.Image and a Fallback of the initials; children replace that content. Empty initials use ?. xsmall uses one initial; other sizes use two. A loaded photo sits on the neutral paint; caller style overrides the computed gradient.

Native DOM attributes, events and refs target this part. Base UI render replaces that target and must preserve its semantic element, ref and merged props; className/style accept state callbacks..

DOM target: **reviewed** — Native div role=listbox with Base UI-generated relationship ID. Native DOM attributes, events and refs target this part. Base UI render replaces that target and must preserve its semantic element, ref and merged props; className/style accept state callbacks..

Control: **reviewed** — Selection belongs to Root: controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue; multiple uses arrays, single uses a value or null. Parts consume that state. Query and open state have independent Base UI control pairs.

Runtime defaults: **reviewed** — Scrollable list, constrained to panel token and available height. Field supplies its label without duplicating the control ID; explicit naming wins and localized choose is the fallback. Render children receive filtered items/groups.

### Combobox.Root

Source: <code>packages/design-system/src/components/combobox.tsx:502</code>. 28 additional inherited props are retained in JSON.

DOM target: **reviewed** — No wrapper DOM node or DOM ref. inputRef targets Base UI’s hidden native form input; name/form apply there..

Control: **reviewed** — Selection belongs to Root: controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue; multiple uses arrays, single uses a value or null. Parts consume that state. Query and open state have independent Base UI control pairs.

Runtime defaults: **reviewed** — Defaults to single selection, no value and a closed popup; uses Ledger locale/direction. Uncontrolled selection resets to defaultValue (or null/[]) after an uncanceled native form reset, including external form ownership. Controlled selection stays caller-owned. Object values need label/value serializers and stable equality; multiple values serialize under repeated names.
